title: Gratin Poutine mit Canadian Bacon
description: A German twist on the classic Canadian poutine dish, topped with a crispy gratin and juicy bacon.

ingredients.name: Juicy Potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into 1/2-inch thick rounds

instructions: In a large pot of salted water, boil the potato slices until they are slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and set them aside.
In a large skillet, cook the Canadian bacon over medium heat until it is crispy and golden brown.
Transfer the bacon to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess grease.
In the same skillet, add the butter and let it melt.
Arrange a layer of potatoes in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Top the potatoes with a layer of Canadian bacon, followed by a layer of grated cheese.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly.
Remove the gratin from the oven and sprinkle with chopped chives if desired.
Serve the gratin hot and enjoy!
